title: Not an MCP server — plain net/http REST API
evidence: main.go:1285-1292 registers REST routes via http.HandleFunc; grep -iE 'mcp|json-?rpc|stdio|RegisterTool|tools/call|initialize' main.go matches only the 'soccer-mcp' module name and one unrelated comment; go.mod has no MCP SDK; _agent_stdout.log states 'no MCP dependency'.
suggestion: Expose the query functions as MCP tools over an MCP server SDK (stdio/JSON-RPC) instead of, or in addition to, REST.

title: FIFA player CSV never loads — 0 players at runtime
evidence: loadPlayers guard 'if len(record) < 100 { continue }' at main.go:493, but every fifa_data.csv row has <=90 fields (header 89, max data row 90 via awk -F, '{print NF}'), so all 18,207 rows are skipped. Match CSVs (5 loaders) do load, so R2 is partial not fully missing.
suggestion: Change the guard to the actual FIFA column count (e.g. len(record) < 89) and align column indices to the header.

title: Player search-by-name non-functional on real data
evidence: GetPlayerByName (main.go:826) is correct and unit-tested, but the test injects synthetic players (main_test.go:512) and never calls LoadData; at runtime s.players is empty (R2), so /api/players?name= returns [].
suggestion: Fix loadPlayers (R2) so the search operates on the loaded FIFA dataset; add a test that loads the real CSV.

title: Player nationality/club filtering non-functional + Brazilian-only
evidence: GetPlayersByClub (main.go:845) and GetBrazilianPlayers (main.go:883) return [] at runtime because s.players is empty (R2). Nationality is hardcoded to Brazilian: playersHandler (main.go:1177) exposes only a 'brazilian' param; grep for Query().Get("nationality") finds no generic nationality filter.
suggestion: Add a generic ?nationality= param backed by a GetPlayersByNationality function, and fix R2 so results are non-empty.

title: loadPlayers column mapping is off-by-index
evidence: Header indices: [1]=ID [2]=Name [3]=Age [6]=Flag [7]=Overall [8]=Potential [9]=Club. But main.go:498 sets age=record[2] (=Name), :499 overall=record[6] (=Flag URL), :500 potential=record[7] (=Overall), :546 club=record[8] (=Potential), :547 position=record[12] (=Special). Even if the <100 guard (R2) is fixed, player Age/Overall/Club/Position would be garbage.
suggestion: Re-map every record[] index to the FIFA header (account for the leading empty BOM column at index 0).
